LEGEND
=======

Player = Foot_Selected
1 = Foot_Selected
2 = Foot_Unselected
. = Background
# = Wall
P = Player
Trail = Trail_N or Trail_S or Trail_W or Trail_E or Trail_Centre
foot = Foot_Selected or Foot_Unselected
cover = wall or trail or foot
halo = f1_halo or f2_halo

F1 = Foot_Selected
F2 = Foot_Unselected
f1_trace = f1 or f1_halo
f2_trace = f2 or f2_halo

object = foot or wall

=======
SOUNDS
=======

================
COLLISIONLAYERS
================

Background
Trail_Centre
Trail_N
Trail_S
Trail_E
Trail_W
Foot, Wall
f1_halo
f2_halo
canceltoken

======
RULES
======

[ up player ] -> [ Trail_N up player ]
[ down player ] -> [ Trail_S down player ]
[ left player ] -> [ Trail_W left player ]
[ right player ] -> [ Trail_E right player ]

[ > player | trail ] -> cancel

[ action Foot_Selected ] [ Foot_Unselected ] -> [ Foot_Unselected ] [ Foot_Selected ]

(feet must be touching orthogonaally or diagonally)


late [ player ] -> [ player canceltoken ]
late [ | f1 ] -> [ f1_halo | f1 ]
late [ | f2 ] -> [ f2_halo | f2 ]
late [ f1_trace f2_trace ] [ canceltoken ] -> [ f1_trace f2_trace ] [ ]
late [ canceltoken ] -> cancel
late [ foot | | foot ] -> cancel

late [ halo ] -> [  ]

==============
WINCONDITIONS
==============

all Background on cover
